request: Tab/window layout membership protection must be independent between browser tabs; protect 1 or 3 profiles while allowing focus changes; individual local profile pin can be released to remove from only that window; unlock window for full add/remove.
cause: Shared monitor.locked field blocked switching and propagated to every window; profile stack was also persisted in shared localStorage.
change: Tab-local sessionStorage state scoped by signed-in participant and trusted chat company: ordered open profiles, active profile, window lock, profile pins.
Switching focuses existing profiles without changing order, regardless of window lock. Adding a profile requires window unlock; profile pins protect removal while locked.
Removing a profile from top strip changes only this tab membership; Settings keeps shared saved profile editing/deletion; deleting shared definitions requires window unlocked.
Window lock pins current membership. Individual pins can be released and removed while window remains locked. Window unlock permits full membership edits.
Explicit New window starts empty/unlocked; reload preserves state in its own tab; old shared monitor.locked is ignored without any backend mutation.
Legacy shared profile stack is read only for first migration; each tab starts unlocked. No ongoing localStorage membership writes. Existing saved profiles and chat slot locks unchanged.
checks: Actual two-browser-tab regression: independent stacks/global locks/profile pins; old shared locked values ignored; 1 and 3 profiles; stable tab order/focus; protected removal; per-profile release/removal; unlock and add; refresh; last profile removed remains empty; explicit popup starts empty; account/company state separation; no server profile writes.
Existing new profile feed lock/reload, generic grid controls, drag/touch/click placement, reader scroll behavior and chat usability/window/copy/profile-type regressions passed.
releaseScope: Hosting only; no Functions/rules/native source, build, installation, live profile or operational data changes.
releaseState: Feature checkpoint; live receipt follows after mandatory preflight and all-file verification.
limitation: Unpushed other-machine work cannot be discovered.
